detail: Completed his secondary education at the public Instituto Ramiro de Maeztu in Madrid, where he also played youth basketball for the Estudiantes club, according to his official La Moncloa biography. He previously attended the Colegio Santa Cristina (Chamartín) for primary education.

institution: Real Centro Universitario Escorial-María Cristina (attached to the Universidad Complutense de Madrid)
qualification: Licenciatura (degree) in Economics and Business Studies (Ciencias Económicas y Empresariales)
detail: Five-year degree obtained in 1995 at the private university centre in San Lorenzo de El Escorial, which awards Complutense degrees.

qualification: Master's degree in the economics of the European Union (Política Económica de la Unión Europea)
detail: Postgraduate study in Brussels, listed in his official biography as a master's in EU economics.

institution: Instituto Universitario Ortega y Gasset (attached to the Universidad Complutense de Madrid)
qualification: Diploma de Estudios Avanzados (advanced studies diploma)
detail: Diploma in advanced studies on European economic and monetary integration, listed in his official biography.

qualification: Executive programme in public-management leadership (Programa de Liderazgo para la Gestión Pública)
detail: Non-degree executive programme; the year is not given in the sources consulted.

Doctoral thesis 'Innovaciones de la diplomacia económica española: análisis del sector público (2000-2012)', supervised by María Isabel Cepeda González and defended in November 2012. He taught economics as an associate lecturer at the same private university between 2008 and 2013. In 2018 several media outlets questioned the originality of parts of the thesis; Sánchez denied any plagiarism and published the full text (see polemics).
